rows.text: As a History Fictionologist, Thym places great emphasis on education through positive reinforcement, which might be related to his not-so-pleasant childhood. To comfort disheartened children, he designed a unique "encouragement" vessel. Whenever a child receives praise, the power of encouragement materializes in front of them as flame, shaped as a thumbs-up. The more encouragement received, the brighter the flame burns. However, when he tried to promote this idea across the universe, he faced opposition from many parents. Because children shouldn't play with fire.
